originalACLQuery.query:
WITH objects(kind,ident,ownerid,rawacl,defaulttype) AS (
 SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')',p.proowner,p.proacl,'f'::"char" FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE (n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid AND d.deptype='e' AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND e.extname='plpgsql')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'relation',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,c.relowner,c.relacl,CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN 'S' ELSE 'r' END::"char" FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'column',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||a.attname,c.relowner,a.attacl,'c'::"char" FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'namespace',nspname,nspowner,nspacl,'n'::"char" FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'type',n.nspname||'.'||t.typname,t.typowner,t.typacl,'T'::"char" FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema' AND (t.typtype IN ('e','d') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c WHERE c.reltype=t.oid))
 UNION ALL SELECT 'default',pg_get_userbyid(a.defaclrole)||':'||coalesce(n.nspname,'')||':'||a.defaclobjtype,a.defaclrole,a.defaclacl,a.defaclobjtype FROM pg_default_acl a LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=a.defaclnamespace
 UNION ALL SELECT 'language',lanname,lanowner,lanacl,'l'::"char" FROM pg_language WHERE lanname='plpgsql'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'database',datname,datdba,datacl,'d'::"char" FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('raw',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(kind,ident,pg_get_userbyid(ownerid),rawacl::text) ORDER BY kind,ident),'[]') FROM objects),
 'expanded',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(o.kind,o.ident,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY o.kind,o.ident,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable),'[]') FROM objects o CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(o.rawacl,acldefault(o.defaulttype,o.ownerid))) a));

rootCauseConclusion.castSufficiency: Sufficient by fixed-version type/operator analysis for this recorded 42725 site; not a claim that the whole proposed query or combined experiment has run successfully.
rootCauseConclusion.reason: The identifier prefix is text; its final operand is catalog internal char. D8-R2 records ambiguous operator selection. An explicit cast of that operand to text yields the built-in exact text/text concatenation.

fifth UNION column, not string concatenation
comparison with 'S'; CASE literals explicitly cast to internal char; no relkind concatenation
nspname/proname/relname/attname/typname and oidvectortypes text; distinct from internal char

separateExistingValueMappingObservation.fact: The relation branch uses uppercase S for sequence defaulttype, whereas acldefault_sql uses lowercase s for sequence and uppercase S for foreign server. This value choice is inherited and is not changed or certified by the identifier cast review.
separateExistingValueMappingObservation.implicationForBoundFixture: The observed source sequence has an explicit non-null relacl, so its COALESCE uses that ACL rather than the fallback. Default-ACL defaclacl is also catalog NOT NULL. No alternative code mapping is added to the proposed patch.
separateExistingValueMappingObservation.limit: This review is not a generic certification of null-sequence ACL fallback; an independent unmet fidelity issue in a future experiment must stop it rather than silently expand this patch.
